assertions.title: Single-cell multiome reveals root hair-specific responses to salt stress.
assertions.paraphrase: Salt and osmotic stress suppress root-hair differentiation and elongation, producing fewer functionally competent root hairs.
assertions.scope_guardrail: Tests the root-hair growth program, not root-hair morphology itself.

scope: leaf and root cell-type heterogeneity under abiotic stress

assertions.title: Single-cell transcriptome atlas of the leaf and root of rice seedlings.
assertions.paraphrase: Rice abiotic-stress transcriptional responses are largely cell-type-specific, while different stresses reuse related programs within a cell type.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The atlas currently audits the salt subset; it does not generalize this statement to every stress assayed in the paper.

assertions.title: Single-cell transcriptomes reveal spatiotemporal heat stress response in maize roots
assertions.paraphrase: Cortex has the largest maize root heat-response DEG burden under both cell-level and pseudobulk analyses.
assertions.scope_guardrail: Registry reliability rank is related but not equivalent to the number of DEGs.

scope: all nine maize root cell types

assertions.title: Single-cell transcriptomes reveal spatiotemporal heat stress response in maize roots
assertions.paraphrase: The heat-shock protein program is induced across all nine maize root cell types.
assertions.scope_guardrail: Direct predefined-module direction test across all registry cell types.

assertions.title: Single-cell transcriptomes reveal spatiotemporal heat stress response in maize roots
assertions.paraphrase: ZNRD15, HSF17 and MAX1b are induced in cortex after heat shock and supported by in situ assays.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The predefined module captures the cortex heat program but not these exact three maize genes.

assertions.title: Single-cell transcriptomes reveal spatiotemporal heat stress response in maize roots
assertions.paraphrase: Phloem, endodermis and pericycle have heat-response patterns distinct from most other maize root cell types.
assertions.scope_guardrail: Tests audited module and reliability heterogeneity, not the original DEG-correlation matrix.

assertions.title: Traceback of Core Transcription Factors for Soybean Root Growth Maintenance under Water Deficit
assertions.paraphrase: A mutually connected core transcription-factor network is proposed to coordinate soybean root-growth maintenance under water deficit.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The atlas tests expression support for the program, not TF binding or causal network topology.

assertions.title: Overexpression of the vascular brassinosteroid receptor BRL3 confers drought resistance without penalizing plant growth.
assertions.paraphrase: Drought-associated BRL3 activity promotes vascular osmoprotectant accumulation, including proline and sugars.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The atlas audits the osmotic program and does not retest the transgenic growth phenotype.

scope: primed versus unprimed root-apex zones under recurrent drought

assertions.title: The different root apex zones contribute to drought priming induced tolerance to a reoccurring drought stress in wheat
assertions.paraphrase: Drought priming maintains growth- and defense-related root-apex expression programs during recurrent drought.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The selected module is one component of the broader priming claim.

assertions.title: Profiling translatomes of discrete cell populations resolves altered cellular priorities during hypoxia in Arabidopsis
assertions.paraphrase: Hypoxia elevates heat-shock mRNAs across the assayed promoter-tagged compartments.
assertions.scope_guardrail: Tests the predefined heat-shock module as an explicit proxy; promoter tags are not standard cell types.

assertions.title: Profiling translatomes of discrete cell populations resolves altered cellular priorities during hypoxia in Arabidopsis
assertions.paraphrase: Hypoxia responses vary between global, regional, and promoter-tagged compartments.
assertions.scope_guardrail: Tests heterogeneous direction patterns, not the original DEG count or translated-mRNA magnitude.

scope: sorted rice root populations across water extremes

assertions.title: Gene regulatory networks shape developmental plasticity of root cell types under water extremes in rice.
assertions.paraphrase: Water availability remodels endodermal and exodermal suberin, iron-transport and nitrogen-assimilation programs in rice roots.
assertions.scope_guardrail: Direction depends on water context and recovery; no single universal sign is asserted.

scope: 15 min rehydration across major leaf cell types

assertions.title: Drought recovery in plants triggers a cell-state-specific immune activation
assertions.paraphrase: Rehydration rapidly induces transcription factors across many leaf cell types.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The predefined hormone-crosstalk module is a declared proxy, not the paper's TF list.

scope: spatial validation in the original study
cotton root salt response and GaGH3.6 validation

assertions.title: Transcriptional Landscape of Cotton Roots in Response to Salt Stress at Single-cell Resolution.
assertions.paraphrase: GaGH3.6 supports cotton salt tolerance through redox regulation, and its silencing increases oxidative damage.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The atlas tests the ROS program, not the exact GaGH3.6 perturbation effect.

scope: trichoblast state transition under osmotic stress

assertions.title: Multiome in the Same Cell Reveals the Impact of Osmotic Stress on Arabidopsis Root Tip Development at Single-Cell Level.
assertions.paraphrase: Osmotic stress shifts trichoblast functional differentiation in the Arabidopsis root tip.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The claim concerns differentiation state; module direction is supportive rather than a direct morphology test.

scope: ABF mutant roots and guard cells
guard cells versus other source tissues

assertions.title: Evolutionary diversity of cell-type-specific expression and stress response in Brassicaceae roots
assertions.paraphrase: ABA and NaCl responses are substantially stress-specific rather than interchangeable.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The audit tests module-direction divergence, not exact DEG-set overlap percentages.

assertions.title: Evolutionary diversity of cell-type-specific expression and stress response in Brassicaceae roots
assertions.paraphrase: Procambium is the highest-ranked Arabidopsis cell type for ABA responsiveness.
assertions.scope_guardrail: Registry reliability rank is an indirect comparison and is not equivalent to Augur AUC.

scope: late progressive-drought phase in tomato leaf

assertions.title: Integrating gene expression analysis and ecophysiological responses to water deficit in leaves of tomato plants.
assertions.paraphrase: Oxidative-stress transcription-factor activation is a late event during progressive tomato leaf drought.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The sign is specific to the late 10-day phase and must not be generalized to early drought.

assertions.title: Dual and spatially resolved drought responses in the Arabidopsis leaf mesophyll revealed by single-cell transcriptomics
assertions.paraphrase: Mesophyll is not the leaf cell type with the largest drought-responsive gene burden.
assertions.scope_guardrail: Registry reliability rank is an indirect metric, not a DEG-count reconstruction.

assertions.title: Dual and spatially resolved drought responses in the Arabidopsis leaf mesophyll revealed by single-cell transcriptomics
assertions.paraphrase: Drought-marker expression, including RD20, increases along the mesophyll drought-response gradient.
assertions.scope_guardrail: RD20 is tested exactly across edgeR, limma and Wilcoxon; the continuous UMAP gradient itself is not reconstructed.

assertions.title: Dual and spatially resolved drought responses in the Arabidopsis leaf mesophyll revealed by single-cell transcriptomics
assertions.paraphrase: The ROS-related gene CSD2 is repressed along the opposing mesophyll drought gradient.
assertions.scope_guardrail: CSD2 is tested exactly across edgeR, limma and Wilcoxon; the continuous UMAP gradient itself is not reconstructed.

assertions.title: Dual and spatially resolved drought responses in the Arabidopsis leaf mesophyll revealed by single-cell transcriptomics
assertions.paraphrase: Two spatially distinct mesophyll populations mount different mild-drought programs.
assertions.scope_guardrail: Major-cell-type auditing can detect module heterogeneity but cannot recreate the two spatial subpopulations.

assertions.title: Dual and spatially resolved drought responses in the Arabidopsis leaf mesophyll revealed by single-cell transcriptomics
assertions.paraphrase: Border- and midvein-associated mesophyll cells show an early ABA drought response.
assertions.scope_guardrail: A broad mesophyll ABA module can miss a localized subpopulation response.

assertions.title: Functional Characterization of PRP43a, a Component for Splicing Disassembly in Arabidopsis
assertions.paraphrase: PRP43a-dependent intron-retention events become prominent under heat stress.
assertions.scope_guardrail: Expression-module reliability cannot fully adjudicate an alternative-splicing claim; no thermotolerance phenotype is claimed.

scope: poplar stem xylem plasticity under severe drought

assertions.title: Single-nucleus transcriptomics revealed auxin-driven mechanisms of wood plasticity to enhance severe drought tolerance in poplar.
assertions.paraphrase: Severe drought remodels xylem-forming cells through auxin-homeostasis changes that support narrower, more numerous vessels.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The atlas tests the vascular hormone program, not vessel anatomy directly.

scope: five sorted Arabidopsis root populations under phosphate limitation

assertions.title: Phosphate starvation induces root cell-type-specific transcriptional responses and alternative splicing
assertions.paraphrase: Phosphate limitation elicits largely cell-type-specific and partly independent transcriptional and alternative-splicing responses.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The current atlas audits expression modules; differential splicing remains an orthogonal layer.

assertions.title: Stress drives plasticity in leaf ageing transcriptional dynamics in Arabidopsis thaliana
assertions.paraphrase: Progressive drought advances leaf-ageing transcriptional programs, especially in mesophyll.
assertions.scope_guardrail: Selected predefined stress modules proxy a much broader ageing program.

assertions.title: Stress drives plasticity in leaf ageing transcriptional dynamics in Arabidopsis thaliana
assertions.paraphrase: A large mesophyll water-deprivation program is induced as stress intensity increases.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The osmotic module is a directional proxy for the larger GO-enriched program.

assertions.title: Stress drives plasticity in leaf ageing transcriptional dynamics in Arabidopsis thaliana
assertions.paraphrase: A 511-gene mesophyll program increases with both development and drought dose and is enriched for osmotic stress.
assertions.scope_guardrail: Tests the same directional process at predefined-module level, not all 511 genes.

assertions.title: Stress drives plasticity in leaf ageing transcriptional dynamics in Arabidopsis thaliana
assertions.paraphrase: Drought activates maturation-associated hormone programs with cell-type-specific distributions.
assertions.scope_guardrail: Predefined ABA and hormone-crosstalk modules proxy a broader set of hormone perturbations.

assertions.title: Stress drives plasticity in leaf ageing transcriptional dynamics in Arabidopsis thaliana
assertions.paraphrase: Drought represses cytokinin- and growth-associated signaling particularly in mesophyll.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The predefined hormone-crosstalk module tests direction but is not a CK-specific gene set.

assertions.title: Stress drives plasticity in leaf ageing transcriptional dynamics in Arabidopsis thaliana
assertions.paraphrase: Mesophyll FRO6 is developmentally induced but transcriptionally repressed by drought.
assertions.scope_guardrail: Exact FRO6 direction is tested in independent R04-R06 data and in replicate-aware DESeq2 and edgeR across R01-R06.

scope: seven rice leaf segments under drought-by-heat factorial treatment

assertions.title: Growth-limiting drought increases sensitivity of Asian rice leaves to heat shock through physiological and spatially distinct transcriptomic responses.
assertions.paraphrase: Growth-limiting drought increases rice leaf sensitivity to heat shock in a spatially nonuniform manner.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The claim is factorial and spatial; it is not a universal drought-only heat-shock response.

assertions.title: Discrete and cell-specific hypoxic responses in Arabidopsis roots resolved by single-nuclei transcriptomics
assertions.paraphrase: Four hours of hypoxia evokes cell-specific transcriptional changes in most root cell types.
assertions.scope_guardrail: Tests heterogeneous module-direction patterns, not the source's DEG magnitude.

scope: developing rice leaf under drought and salinity at different intensities

assertions.title: Drought and salinity stress remodel Asian rice leaf development through cell-type-specific regulatory programs.
assertions.paraphrase: Moderate osmotic stress preferentially perturbs early developmental cells and activates networks that inhibit cell division.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The claim contrasts moderate with mild stress and should retain intensity and developmental-stage qualifiers.

scope: FACS-isolated Arabidopsis cortex and pericycle under salt

assertions.title: Cell type-specific transcriptional responses of plants to salinity
assertions.paraphrase: Arabidopsis root cortex water-transport programs are suppressed by salinity, and cortical cells respond more strongly than vascular cells.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The anchor is French; water transport is one of the three pathways enumerated immediately after it.

scope: four radial root layers across six salt time points

assertions.title: A spatio-temporal understanding of growth regulation during the salt stress response in Arabidopsis
assertions.paraphrase: Salt produces tissue-specific and time-specific root transcriptional responses.
assertions.scope_guardrail: Tests whether module directions vary across layer/time axes, not the original magnitude or pathway assignments.

scope: maize fifth-leaf growth zone under drought and rewatering

assertions.title: Drought Induces Distinct Growth Response, Protection, and Recovery Mechanisms in the Maize Leaf Growth Zone.
assertions.paraphrase: Increasing antioxidant capacity in the maize leaf proliferation zone stimulates cell division and leaf growth under drought.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The atlas audits the ROS program; the growth rescue comes from an independent perturbation in the same study.

assertions.title: Time-Series Transcriptomics Reveals That AGAMOUS-LIKE22 Affects Primary Metabolism and Developmental Processes in Drought-Stressed Arabidopsis.
assertions.paraphrase: Progressive drought triggers early transcriptional and carbon-assimilation changes before a late rise in foliar ABA.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The ABA rise is late-phase specific; early drought should not be labeled ABA-up from this claim.

scope: rice heat and dehydration regulatory-network analysis

assertions.title: EGRINs in Rice That Function in the Response to Water Deficit, High Temperature, and Agricultural Environments.
assertions.paraphrase: Rice environmental regulatory networks assign distinct stress roles to heat-shock-factor family members.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The atlas tests heat-shock program behavior, not every inferred TF-target edge.

scope: root cell layers and developmental stages under salinity

assertions.title: Cell identity mediates the response of Arabidopsis roots to abiotic stress.
assertions.paraphrase: Arabidopsis root salt responses are strongly constrained by developmental stage and cell-layer identity.
assertions.scope_guardrail: This is a heterogeneity claim and has no single expected module direction.

scope: wheat root and leaf nuclei after seven days of NaCl

assertions.title: Single-nucleus RNA sequencing reveals transcriptional response of wheat roots and leaves to salt stress
assertions.paraphrase: Late wheat salt stress induces cell-type programs involving osmotic stress, ion transport and oxidative stress.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The current atlas admits replicate-eligible root contexts; leaf claims remain outside this exact-route subset.

scope: wheat root-hair salt response across tolerant and sensitive varieties

assertions.title: Cell-Type-Specific and Variety-Specific Responses to Salt Stress in Wheat Root Revealed by Single-Cell Transcriptomics.
assertions.paraphrase: TaGSTU1-5B overexpression improves wheat salt tolerance through enhanced ROS scavenging, following root-hair-focused discovery.
assertions.scope_guardrail: The atlas tests the root-hair ROS program; causal validation is gene-specific.
